units.rationale: All eight calls resolve to concrete OperationSpec routes in regression_operation_adapter.py (app.relaunch 2157, navigation.select-tab 2188, media.open 2319, playback.await-window-state 2404, transition-trace.arm 2448, format.apply 2430, transition-trace.fetch 2460, transition-trace.disarm 2461) and all support the declared device lane. The single prerequisite presentation-fixtures-ready is owned by Regression/preparations/presentation-fixtures-device.md for this lane, so no human actor is needed. The result:// reference on calls 07 and 08 reads generationToken from call 05, which transition-trace.arm declares as its result field, so the ordering closes. The one static case default binds obligation o01 to oracle:agent-structured-transition@1, whose registered evidence pair transition.trace/transition-trace@1 is exactly what transition-trace.fetch@1 produces at adapter line 2460. The rubric names 1280x720 and the four enumerated state values, so every criterion is structurally decidable, and its three negative controls separate controller-only success, malformed or reordered traces, and wrong end states from established failure. estimatedCostMillis 150000 is a plausible upper bound for one relaunch plus one open plus one format application on device.
